    - heading "Migrate, modernize, and stay modern with agentic AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Enterprise transformation rarely ends with a single project. Infrastructure must move off legacy platforms, decades-old applications need modernizing, and technical debt keeps growing as AI speeds up code creation. Legacy systems are risky to change, so many programs stall or stretch into years. AWS Transform uses agentic AI to accelerate and de-risk each stage of that journey. It migrates infrastructure, modernizes applications such as Mainframe and Windows, and continuously fixes technical debt across your portfolio, so your teams spend less time maintaining legacy systems and more time on innovation.

      - heading "Continuous tech debt analysis and remediation at scale" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Turn reactive, manual software maintenance into proactive, continuous modernization. AWS Transform continuous modernization shifts code transformation from periodic projects into an always-on, autonomous practice, evolving your pipeline toward CI/CD/CM (continuous modernization). Get full visibility into tech debt across thousands of repositories and autonomously detect, prioritize, remediate, and document common findings like end-of-life dependencies, outdated frameworks, and security vulnerabilities. Replace recurring fire drills with steady, measurable progress at scale.
